kaikki_vikisozluk.e:
نستبرأ (form X)
# نُسْتَبْرَأُ (nustabraʔu) /nus.tab.ra.ʔu/: first-person plural non-past passive indicative of اِسْتَبْرَأَ (istabraʔa)
# نُسْتَبْرَأَ (nustabraʔa) /nus.tab.ra.ʔa/: first-person plural non-past passive subjunctive of اِسْتَبْرَأَ (istabraʔa)
# نُسْتَبْرَأْ (nustabraʔ) /nus.tab.raʔ/: first-person plural non-past passive jussive of اِسْتَبْرَأَ (istabraʔa)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
